subject: Change vector of length P*P to a P by P matrix?

messages.author: 29ce8550baceaeb0
messages.subject: Change vector of length P*P to a P by P matrix?
parts:
Hi all, 

Quick question - is there an equivalent to R's matrix(myvector, nrow, ncol) in stan? That is, something that would undo to_vector(mymatrix)? I've done a bit of hunting through the mail-list/manual but searches that include super-unique keywords like "change" "vector" and "matrix" don't get me far. 

All the best, 
Jim

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Change vector of length P*P to a P by P matrix?
parts:
The place to hunt is the matrix section of the reference
manual's listing of Stan functions.

But no, there's not something to do that. But there
should be, so I created a feature request:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1452

If someone wants to implement this, it's very easy because
there is no fancy templating required and no analytic
derivatives to plumb through --- just a simple function.

- Bob
